list.title: Lead sources
list.intro: Enquiries your agency collects elsewhere arrive here by themselves. We only read your sheets: nothing is ever written to them.
list.heading: Google Sheets
list.empty: No sheet is connected. Connect the Google Sheet your form fills, and its new rows become leads by themselves.
list.limitHint: You can connect up to {limit} sheets. Disconnect one to connect another.
list.notSetUp: Google Sheets isn't set up on this server.

connect.title: Connect a sheet
connect.intro: New answers in your Google Sheet become leads here by themselves. We only read the sheet and never change it.
connect.caption: Step {step} of 3 · {name}

share.addressTitle: {count, plural, one {Share your sheet with this address} other {Share your sheet with any one of these addresses}}
share.help: In your sheet press Share, paste the address and choose Viewer. We can only read, never change.
share.linkHint: Copy it from your browser's address bar.

columns.title: Match columns
columns.intro: Sheet ‘{sheet}’, tab ‘{tab}’. Say what each column holds; we remember it.
columns.tabHint: The tab whose rows become leads.
columns.readyBody: A name and a phone, email or Instagram are matched.
columns.needContact: A phone, email or Instagram is matched
columns.ownerValues: Values of ‘{column}’ ({count, plural, one {# different value} other {# different values}})
columns.manyValues: ‘{column}’ has too many different values to match one by one. Every row goes to the agency's Owner.
columns.loadFailed: We couldn't read this sheet's columns.

existing.title: Rows already in the sheet
existing.question: {count, plural, one {Your sheet already has # row. What should we do with it?} other {Your sheet already has # rows. What should we do with them?}}
existing.capped: Your sheet has {count} rows; the newest {limit} can be checked.
existing.onlyNew: Only new rows from now on
existing.onlyNewHint: Nothing already in the sheet is added. New answers become leads.
existing.check: Also check the {count} rows already there
existing.checkHint: You'll see a preview first. Anyone who already has a lead with you is left out unless you tick them.
existing.note: Either way, rows that are in the sheet now are never added by the sync later, even if the sheet is sorted.
existing.legend: What to do with the rows already there
existing.confirmDescription: New rows will become leads about every 15 minutes. Sync now brings them at once. We never change your sheet.
existing.loadFailed: We couldn't read this sheet's rows.
existing.readingWait: This takes a moment for a long sheet. You can leave this page: it carries on.

sheet.subtitle: Tab ‘{tab}’ · connected by {name} on {day}
sheet.lastChecked: Last checked {when} · checks about every 15 minutes
sheet.notChecked: Not checked yet · checks about every 15 minutes
sheet.late: Checks are running late. Sync now checks it at once.

counts.heading: Since you connected
counts.notes: Rows already in the sheet when you connected are not counted, and a row you change after it was added counts as a repeat enquiry.
counts.truncated: Only the first 20,000 rows are read. Move older rows to another tab.

problems.heading: Couldn't be added
problems.help: Fix the row in your sheet: the next check adds it and clears this line.

lost_access.title: We can't open this sheet any more
lost_access.body: It may have been unshared or deleted. Share it again with this address as a Viewer, then check again. Rows that arrive meanwhile wait in the sheet and are added once we can open it.

tab_missing.title: This sheet's tab is gone
tab_missing.body: ‘{tab}’ isn't in the sheet any more. Choose the tab that holds your rows now. Rows already added are not added again.
tab_missing.label: Tab

columns_missing.title: A column we need is gone
columns_missing.body: This sheet no longer has {columns}. Match the columns again. Rows that arrive meanwhile wait in the sheet.

needs_manager.title: This sheet needs a manager
needs_manager.body: The person who connected it can't add leads any more. Take it over to carry on reading it as yourself.

readOnly.title: Paused while your subscription is read-only
readOnly.body: Rows wait in the sheet and are added when it's active again.

paused.title: This sheet is paused
paused.body: Rows wait in the sheet and are added when you resume.

matchAgainDialog.title: Save the new match?
matchAgainDialog.description: Rows already added are not added again.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect ‘{sheet}’?
disconnectDialog.description: Leads already added stay. We stop reading the sheet and forget its rows' record, so connecting it again asks about its rows once more. Nothing in your sheet changes; you may also remove <email>{address}</email> from its sharing.

reasons.no_contact: No phone, email or Instagram we can use
reasons.erased: A customer who asked to be erased
